info.title: Genius Decision — agent integration API
info.description: Genius bounded beta: HTTP agent integration subset. Public discovery; no-human-registration synthetic demo; automatic machine registration for synthetic/non-personal data; separate existing human-account keys. Machine Bearer keys are scoped, revocable and expire after 7 days (demo: 1 hour). Rotation only retains/reduces scopes. Human keys retain full account permissions. No MCP or OAuth. HTTP acceptance is distinct from formal admission and empirical evidence. Body limit 128 KiB; input limit 110000 JSON bytes. Declared choice profile: /static/decisions.html; explicit review and confirmation required. No general narrative solver or real-world CAG/PVS claim.

post.summary: Create an isolated machine space without human login
post.description: Only synthetic or non-personal data. No email, password, adult confirmation or human consent fields. Response secret is shown once. Not idempotent; avoid blind retries after a lost response. Default scopes are cases:read, cases:write, jobs:run and account:delete. Twin access is opt-in via twins:read, twins:write, twins:evaluate and twins:delete. Twin REST contracts: https://github.com/pedrosalvadeo/genius-decision-open/blob/main/beta/docs/AGENT_TWIN.md. Read twin.available in the agent manifest before use.
